description: In 1923, the Orient Express stops at the Polish town of Węgrów. The investigators disembark, have their first encounter with the mysterious woman Yamina, and are immediately caught in a street gunfight, escaping in a bus amidst the chaos.

conversation.speaker: player1
conversation.text: A new story begins, wish you all a pleasant journey! Recording for Bread or Stone (Węgrów 1923) has now started... Wait, a piece of paper flew out... Rabbit head rabbit head open your mouth, let me know what cup I am. He pushes me outside the list, saying I'm not worthy yet.

conversation.speaker: player5
conversation.text: After the train slowly pulled into Węgrów station, it stopped moving forward. The friction sound between the wheels and the rails completely disappeared, leaving only the low hum of the power system. You didn't pay attention at first, continuing your pleasant conversation, until you noticed the minute hand on the platform clock outside the window had quietly completed a full circle. Other passengers also began to look around uneasily; some repeatedly checked the timetable on their tickets, the conductor's figure hurried past at the end of the corridor. The entire Orient Express seemed frozen by magic at this nameless small station. Suddenly, the attendant's fingers tapped out a rapid knocking sound on the other side of the door.

conversation.speaker: player4
conversation.text: #Get up, search for a while, decide to open the door.

conversation.speaker: player6
conversation.text: "What's the matter? And why hasn't the train departed yet?" #Glance at pocket watch, then put it back inside coat.

conversation.speaker: player5
conversation.text: After the door opened, the attendant bowed slightly in apology. He explained that anarchists' bomb attacks had damaged the main track switch. As the switch needs three days to repair, passengers will be forced to stay in the town. Please all passengers take your carry-on luggage and disembark now.

conversation.speaker: player6
conversation.text: "Alright then, can't stay here for now." #Johnson takes luggage from the rack, gets ready, then helps move out companions' belongings.

conversation.speaker: player5
conversation.text: Several uniformed police officers stand on the platform, some equipped with rifles. The train conductor announces to the passengers in a restrained, steady voice: "Ladies and gentlemen, due to an unexpected incident, the train's passage is delayed. We apologize for asking everyone to disembark. Please have your passports ready for inspection."

conversation.speaker: player6
conversation.text: "So, shall we find accommodation first?" #Johnson looks on the platform for a convenience store selling maps.

conversation.speaker: player5
conversation.text: Passengers are forming a winding line slowly moving forward. It seems you'll have to stand in line for inspection for now. A cold wind blows across the platform; people tighten their coats and lower their heads to wait. Officers check documents one by one, pens scratching on the register with a rustling sound.

conversation.speaker: player6
conversation.text: #Take out documents from leather jacket, blow on hands and rub them, waiting bored. "A bit cold."

conversation.speaker: player5
conversation.text: A silent attendant hands over a neatly folded local newspaper, the edges still warm from the printing press. The front page carries a blurry photo of a railway accident, but the entire article is written in Serbo-Croatian, which none of you understand. However, the cover has an interesting photo, seemingly of an archaeological excavation. The photo shows an underground room, with tools and artifacts scattered on the ground.

conversation.speaker: player6
conversation.text: #Perk up, take it to compare, see what era the artifacts on it are from.

conversation.speaker: player4
conversation.text: .ra Archaeology

conversation.speaker: player1
conversation.text: Belief arises from desire; if it's what you hope for, it will be answered. <player4>'s Archaeology prayer: D100=7/78 Extreme success - You hold on, let me be extreme first!

conversation.speaker: player4
conversation.text: "Sorry, got a bit distracted." #Lazily yawn, then appear here like a ghost. "Let me see what's on it."

conversation.speaker: player6
conversation.text: "No, it's our first time here. Not communists." #Point to the companions next to me who are clearly much wealthier, "These are my friends, officer." #Answer while looking at the newspaper. #Seeing Bai Lan took the newspaper, focus attention on dealing with the officer. #Hand the newspaper to Bai Lan.

conversation.speaker: player5
conversation.text: Bai Lan can identify these as artifacts of 13th-century Byzantine culture. Considering the historical context, they might be spoils brought back locally from the 1204 Crusade. Finally, it's your turn. The stern officer who calls himself Captain Velemiir Kakunika takes the documents with his white-gloved fingers. His gaze sweeps over each person's face like a hawk. This Bosnian officer's questions have a cold, hard rhythm: "Have you visited this region before? Declare your occupation? Are you involved in communist organizations? Level of knowledge about the People's Justice Army? Any military service experience? Possess knowledge of explosive device operation?" His pen hovers above the register, waiting to record.

conversation.speaker: player6
conversation.text: #Hand over the prepared passport for the officer's inspection. "We are all upstanding citizens. We know nothing about the People's Justice Army or such things. But I can guarantee none of us know how to operate explosives. You can have sniffer dogs check us."

conversation.speaker: player5
conversation.text: Captain Kakunika's pen makes clear checkmarks on the register. Without looking up, he waves you through. The next passenger is guided to the table by a gendarme. The captain repeats in the same stern tone: "Present your documents." His fingertips lightly tap the table, his gaze already shifting to the new subject of inquiry.

conversation.speaker: player6
conversation.text: "Also haven't served in the military, I'm long past conscription age." #A middle-aged man with a face full of wrinkles. #Signal to companions, look for a convenience store selling maps.

conversation.speaker: player4
conversation.text: #Politely present documents, then the usual spiel stating identity and purpose of academic exchange.

conversation.speaker: player5
conversation.text: Dear passengers, we deeply apologize. Staff of the Compagnie Internationale des Wagons-Lits stand on the platform and say, the train cannot proceed to Belgrade until the track repairs are completed, expected to take three to four days. The switch was deliberately blown up by anarchists, but rest assured, no one was injured; your safety is always guaranteed. These things happen occasionally in these parts. Some passengers appear frustrated by the delay and inspection, while others are excited by this unexpected episode. Several Austrian and Russian passengers are being led off the platform by police. The official announces three options to passengers: You can stay in Węgrów and wait for service to resume for priority boarding; you can arrange your own motorcycle transport to Belgrade to rejoin the train; or take the original train back to Zagreb and depart again after the railway is repaired. The announcement paper in his hand trembles slightly in the cold wind. "Passengers choosing to stay in Węgrów, the company has booked rooms at the 'Hunting Castle' lodge and will cover all costs. The lodge offers paid hunting and guide services; related expenses will be compensated by the company. Staff hope this alleviates the inconvenience of the delay. Please be sure to stay within the lodge grounds upon arrival, unless accompanied by hotel staff when going out. Currently, Węgrów is in a special period hunting anarchists; the local situation remains unstable."

conversation.speaker: player4
conversation.text: "What do you all decide?"

conversation.speaker: player6
conversation.text: "Professor Bai Lan, that archaeological site is local, right? If so, then let's stay and go take a look."

conversation.speaker: player5
conversation.text: Porters are moving the remaining luggage from the carriages; several taxis wait by the roadside. Passengers gradually board vehicles, preparing to go to the ferry dock to transfer to the hotel. The roar of engines and the rolling sound of suitcase wheels intertwine. Passengers staying in Węgrów, please board the bus over there! Staff direct by the roadside.

conversation.speaker: player4
conversation.text: "How about we stay here for a while, wait for the railway to be restored in the kitchen, and by the way, check out that archaeological discovery."

conversation.speaker: player6
conversation.text: "Right, let's get on the bus first." #Carry two people's luggage with both hands, go to place them in the lower luggage rack. #After finding seats on the bus, take the newspaper and ask the attendant if they can read this archaeological news segment for me.

conversation.speaker: player5
conversation.text: The next empty taxi hasn't arrived yet; looks like you'll have to wait here a bit longer.

conversation.text: While waiting for an available taxi by the roadside, the investigators notice a woman rushing over with a suitcase, followed by a man in a dark hat.

conversation.speaker: player8
conversation.text: #Walking along the road carrying a suitcase, eyes constantly scanning the passersby. Suddenly, two individuals dressed distinctly unlike locals catch my eye. Most crucially, in the crowd, I instantly recognize Bai Lan as a lesbian. I maintain my pace, shift direction, and walk towards the investigators. When about a meter away, I spread my arms in a gesture of affection, giving Bai Lan a big hug. Simultaneously, I rest my head on Bai Lan's shoulder and whisper, "I'm being followed, help me."

conversation.speaker: player6
conversation.text: #The cigarette just placed in my mouth, not even lit yet, falls to the ground, leaving only a wide-open mouth staring at this scene.

conversation.speaker: player5
conversation.text: The follower shouts loudly in Serbo-Croatian. A van suddenly appears, stopping diagonally next to the taxi. Two men rush out of the vehicle trying to grab player8. The overturned suitcase scrapes across the cobblestones with a piercing sound.

conversation.speaker: player4
conversation.text: "Well, dear lady, do you need to do something?"

conversation.speaker: player8
conversation.text: "Run first."

conversation.speaker: player4
conversation.text: #Grabbing this lady's hand, ready to make a quick escape.

conversation.speaker: player5
conversation.text: Then Bai Lan notices two men behind player8 charging forward with daggers. The man with the dark hat pulls a pistol from his pocket.

conversation.speaker: player6
conversation.text: #Realizing what this is, damn cultists, fight!

conversation.speaker: player4
conversation.text: #Look around, searching for any police. Open the trench coat, casually pull out the gun holstered at my waist, aim at the man in the dark hat, and fire two shots. .rap pistol 2#

conversation.speaker: player6

conversation.speaker: player5
conversation.text: The three quickly board the bus and find seats. The moment the doors close, the engine roars to life. As the vehicle drives away from the docks, through the window you can see the police just rushing into the crime scene, the badges on their caps reflecting sporadic flashes of sunlight. The bus tires roll over the seams of the cobblestone road, leaving the bloody scene far behind.

conversation.speaker: player4

conversation.speaker: player5
conversation.text: "Hunting Castle" is accurately translated as "Hunter's Manor." This complex of luxurious hunting lodges features spacious rooms with roaring indoor fireplaces and large, comfortable beds. The decor is filled with hunting elements: trophy antlers hang on the walls, animal specimens are placed throughout, and bear skin rugs cover the floors. The Roncal family, who run the manor, are hospitable. Though lacking international hospitality experience, they always strive to meet guests' needs. Besides Croatian, they can also communicate in German. The kitchen serves hearty traditional dishes: Sarma stuffed cabbage rolls, Podvarak sauerkraut stew with meat, Cevapi grilled meat sausages. The daily menu depends on guests' hunting harvests from the Kunivich Reserve. The cellar is stocked with abundant local beverages: Rakia fruit brandy, Graevina white wine, Pelinkovac bitter herbal liqueur. The bus arrives as the guide elaborates on these features.

conversation.speaker: player8
conversation.text: #Quickly wait for the investigators to pack up.

conversation.speaker: player5
conversation.text: A noblewoman in a mink coat clutches her pearl handbag and repeatedly steps back: "This is simply a barbarian's den! I must return to civilized society at once!" She continually demands in both English and French to arrange a carriage back to Zagreb. Several gentlemanly travelers sit calmly on bear skin chairs sipping Rakia. One, twirling his mustache, tells the butler in German: "The hunting theme suits me perfectly." In a corner, a group of young men and women excitedly try out workshop hunting rifles, their Russian mixed with laughter: "Look at these fine weapons! We must bag a wild boar tomorrow!"

conversation.speaker: player6
conversation.text: #Check in at the front desk, then go pack and settle into the room.

conversation.speaker: player5
conversation.text: Next, the course of action is up to you to decide freely.

conversation.speaker: player4
conversation.text: "Let's go. Do you know where your father is staying?"

conversation.speaker: player5
conversation.text: Johnson pushes open the oak door. A moose head trophy covering an entire wall greets the eye, its glass eyes reflecting the dancing flames from the fireplace. The double bed is covered with a heavy wolf fur blanket, the bedposts carved with pinecone and hunting dog patterns. A locked gun cabinet stands in the corner. The walnut wardrobe has handles inlaid with wild boar tusks. A Bosnian carpet lies spread with an unfolded hunting map. A copper kerosene lamp casts a warm glow from the nightstand.

conversation.speaker: player8
conversation.text: #State the hotel's address.

conversation.speaker: player6
conversation.text: "Wow, full-on hunting vibe, and I get to sleep in a big bed." #Lie down on it to try, sink in. After dozing for a bit, ask the front desk clerk for a glass of white wine and a local map.

conversation.speaker: player5
conversation.text: "Dear sir, the hunting rifles are all kept in the copper-edged oak cabinets. Each Beretta double-barreled shotgun is registered with a number," a waiter explains in English with a German accent, lightly tapping the leather register on the counter. "Please present your passport and sign this liability waiver. A deposit of 25 gold marks is required, fully refunded upon return of the firearm. Ten rounds of ammunition are issued daily and must be used under the guide's supervision."
